scope: Finite TRAIN constraints/repair only; not independently verified whole-domain accuracy or product promotion.
interpretation: Canonical fixed margins repair the prior shrinking-margin defect and preserve the finite canonical-correct Top-5 anchor set.
Top-1 protection applies to 831 rows across 351 classes, Top-5 protection to 1005 rows across 370 classes; do not claim every class or unseen writer/device is protected.
Eight of the eleven source TRAIN Top-1 losses are zero-to-O/o/circle-style confusions; two are eight-to-f and one is nine-to-eight.
All eleven targets remain reachable in Top-5. This local tradeoff is ranking/selection drift, not disappearance of the target candidate; it does not prove a decoder can recover them in real formulas.
Keep the failed repair as research evidence; do not weaken the 90% gate to relabel the experiment successful.
next_hypothesis: Retain source and prior newly rescued TRAIN examples jointly during constrained optimization, instead of protecting only canonical-correct anchors post hoc. A fresh experiment must predeclare this and still pass independent acceptance before promotion.
